title: Attacker url observed in the wild: oast.pro (OffSeq Mirage)
description: The URL 'oast.pro' has been observed in attacker activity involving ingress tool transfer (T1105) on 2026-11-02. This URL was seen in attacker payloads used for tool download, callback, or exploitation targeting. The activity originated from attacker infrastructure located in France. Security teams are advised to block and monitor this URL and search their proxy, web, or WAF logs for any requests to it.
